content: Sequential doc numbers in PG: bare sequences are never gapless (nextval not rolled back). count()+1/max()+1 are concurrency-unsafe without a unique constraint. Patterns: (a) sequence + unique constraint + accept gaps, (b) counter row UPDATE ... FOR UPDATE (gapless, serializes), (c) Serializable tx + P2034 retry. Gapless serializes all creators -- usually unique+sequences is enough for BAST numbering.
